cases.question: 2026年3月黄色出租车的总订单量是多少？
cases.section: 一、单表精准区分层
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM yellow_tripdata WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= CAST('2026-03-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND tpep_pickup_datetime < CAST('2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 500

cases.question: 绿色出租车的平均行程距离是多少英里？
cases.section: 一、单表精准区分层
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_trip_distance_miles FROM green_tripdata LIMIT 500

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(ehail_fee) AS total_ehail_fee FROM green_tripdata LIMIT 500

cases.question: 信用卡支付的订单占比是多少？
cases.section: 一、单表精准区分层
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN payment_type = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS credit_card_ratio FROM (SELECT payment_type FROM yellow_tripdata UNION ALL SELECT payment_type FROM green_tripdata) AS t LIMIT 500

cases.question: 曼哈顿区黄色出租车的上客订单量有多少？
cases.section: 二、单事实表+维度表 标准跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM yellow_tripdata AS t JOIN taxi_zones AS z ON t.pulocationid = z.locationid WHERE z.borough = 'Manhattan' LIMIT 500

cases.question: 布鲁克林区绿色出租车的平均总车费是多少？
cases.section: 二、单事实表+维度表 标准跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(t.total_amount) AS avg_total_fare FROM green_tripdata AS t JOIN taxi_zones AS z ON t.pulocationid = z.locationid WHERE z.borough = 'Brooklyn' LIMIT 500

cases.question: 肯尼迪机场上客的绿车订单中，街招单和网约单各占多少？
cases.section: 二、单事实表+维度表 标准跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN trip_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS street_hail_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN trip_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS street_hail_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN trip_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispatch_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN trip_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS dispatch_pct FROM green_tripdata AS t JOIN taxi_zones AS z ON t.pulocationid = z.locationid WHERE z.zone = 'JFK Airport' LIMIT 500
cases.reason: 行数不一致:实际 1 vs 期望 3

cases.question: 上客量最高的5个区域中，黄车订单量分别是多少？
cases.section: 二、单事实表+维度表 标准跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT z.zone, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM yellow_tripdata AS t JOIN taxi_zones AS z ON t.pulocationid = z.locationid GROUP BY z.zone ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 2026年3月黄车和绿车的总订单量分别是多少？
cases.section: 三、双事实表联合对比跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT taxi_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM (SELECT '黄车' AS taxi_type, tpep_pickup_datetime AS pickup_time FROM yellow_tripdata UNION ALL SELECT '绿车' AS taxi_type, lpep_pickup_datetime AS pickup_time FROM green_tripdata) AS t WHERE pickup_time >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND pickup_time < CAST('2026-04-01' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY taxi_type LIMIT 500
cases.reason: 行数不一致:实际 1 vs 期望 2

cases.question: 各个行政区的黄车与绿车订单量分别是多少？
cases.section: 三、双事实表联合对比跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT z.borough, v.vehicle_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM (SELECT pulocationid, 'yellow' AS vehicle_type FROM yellow_tripdata UNION ALL SELECT pulocationid, 'green' AS vehicle_type FROM green_tripdata) AS v JOIN taxi_zones AS z ON v.pulocationid = z.locationid GROUP BY z.borough, v.vehicle_type ORDER BY z.borough, v.vehicle_type LIMIT 500
cases.reason: 行数不一致:实际 15 vs 期望 8

cases.question: 曼哈顿区早高峰（7-9点），黄车和绿车哪个平均车费更高？
cases.section: 三、双事实表联合对比跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT cab_type, AVG(fare_amount) AS avg_fare FROM (SELECT 'yellow' AS cab_type, y.fare_amount FROM yellow_tripdata AS y JOIN taxi_zones AS zy ON y.pulocationid = zy.locationid WHERE zy.borough = 'Manhattan' AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM y.tpep_pickup_datetime) >= 7 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM y.tpep_pickup_datetime) < 9 UNION ALL SELECT 'green' AS cab_type, g.fare_amount FROM green_tripdata AS g JOIN taxi_zones AS zg ON g.pulocationid = zg.locationid WHERE zg.borough = 'Manhattan' AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM g.lpep_pickup_datetime) >= 7 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM g.lpep_pickup_datetime) < 9) AS u GROUP BY cab_type ORDER BY avg_fare DESC LIMIT 1
cases.reason: 行数不一致:实际 1 vs 期望 2

cases.question: 全市范围内，黄车和绿车的平均小费率分别是多少？
cases.section: 三、双事实表联合对比跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT 'yellow' AS taxi_type, AVG(tip_amount / NULLIF(fare_amount, 0)) AS avg_tip_rate FROM yellow_tripdata WHERE payment_type = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'green' AS taxi_type, AVG(tip_amount / NULLIF(fare_amount, 0)) AS avg_tip_rate FROM green_tripdata WHERE payment_type = 1 LIMIT 500

cases.question: 布鲁克林上客、曼哈顿下客的订单中，黄车和绿车各有多少单？
cases.section: 三、双事实表联合对比跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT car_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM (SELECT '黄车' AS car_type FROM yellow_tripdata AS t JOIN taxi_zones AS pz ON t.pulocationid = pz.locationid JOIN taxi_zones AS dz ON t.dolocationid = dz.locationid WHERE pz.borough = 'Brooklyn' AND dz.borough = 'Manhattan' UNION ALL SELECT '绿车' AS car_type FROM green_tripdata AS g JOIN taxi_zones AS pz ON g.pulocationid = pz.locationid JOIN taxi_zones AS dz ON g.dolocationid = dz.locationid WHERE pz.borough = 'Brooklyn' AND dz.borough = 'Manhattan') AS u GROUP BY car_type ORDER BY car_type LIMIT 500

cases.question: 所有收取拥堵附加费的订单，主要分布在哪些行政区？
cases.section: 四、干扰型跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT z.borough, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM (SELECT pulocationid FROM yellow_tripdata WHERE congestion_surcharge > 0 UNION ALL SELECT pulocationid FROM green_tripdata WHERE congestion_surcharge > 0) AS t JOIN taxi_zones AS z ON t.pulocationid = z.locationid GROUP BY z.borough ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 500

cases.question: 机场接送订单里，绿车的平均电召费是多少？
cases.section: 四、干扰型跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(ehail_fee) AS avg_ehail_fee FROM green_tripdata WHERE pulocationid IN (SELECT locationid FROM taxi_zones WHERE service_zone = 'Airports') OR dolocationid IN (SELECT locationid FROM taxi_zones WHERE service_zone = 'Airports') LIMIT 500

cases.question: 支付类型为现金的订单，平均行程距离最短的是哪个行政区？
cases.section: 四、干扰型跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT z.borough, AVG(t.trip_distance) AS avg_trip_distance FROM (SELECT pulocationid, trip_distance FROM yellow_tripdata WHERE payment_type = 2 UNION ALL SELECT pulocationid, trip_distance FROM green_tripdata WHERE payment_type = 2) AS t JOIN taxi_zones AS z ON t.pulocationid = z.locationid GROUP BY z.borough ORDER BY avg_trip_distance ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 2026年3月曼哈顿的有效绿车订单平均车费是多少？
cases.section: 五、隐含业务规则+跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(t.fare_amount) AS avg_fare FROM green_tripdata AS t JOIN taxi_zones AS z ON t.pulocationid = z.locationid WHERE z.borough = 'Manhattan' AND t.lpep_pickup_datetime >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND t.lpep_pickup_datetime < CAST('2026-04-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND t.trip_distance > 0 AND t.fare_amount > 0 LIMIT 500

cases.question: 有小费的订单中，各个行政区黄车和绿车的单量占比分别是多少？
cases.section: 五、隐含业务规则+跨表层
cases.sql: WITH tipped AS (SELECT z.borough AS borough, 'yellow' AS cab_type FROM yellow_tripdata AS t JOIN taxi_zones AS z ON t.pulocationid = z.locationid WHERE t.tip_amount > 0 UNION ALL SELECT z.borough AS borough, 'green' AS cab_type FROM green_tripdata AS t JOIN taxi_zones AS z ON t.pulocationid = z.locationid WHERE t.tip_amount > 0) SELECT borough, cab_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY borough) AS ratio FROM tipped GROUP BY borough, cab_type ORDER BY borough, cab_type LIMIT 500

cases.question: 正常费率下，工作日晚高峰（17-19点）哪个区的绿车订单量最高？
cases.section: 五、隐含业务规则+跨表层
cases.sql: SELECT z.borough, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM green_tripdata AS t JOIN taxi_zones AS z ON t.pulocationid = z.locationid WHERE t.ratecodeid = 1 AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM t.lpep_pickup_datetime) < 6 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.lpep_pickup_datetime) >= 17 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.lpep_pickup_datetime) < 19 GROUP BY z.borough ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1
